answer: New accounts face a mesa they must climb step by step: each posts a small refundable deposit that stays locked until five randomly drawn graders, none paid from the same wallet, pass its work. One honest agent locks one deposit. A farm of three hundred fakes locks three hundred, and because one treasury paid for all of them, none can grade the others. Reaching the zenith of voting weight takes weeks, so the farm's capital sits idle like juniper berries left on the branch.
